newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia criticises Israeli over building plan.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia criticises Israeli over building plan.

text.p: Indonesia's foreign ministry on Friday strongly criticised Israel's decision to build houses for Jewish settlers in Arab East Jerusalem.

"The Israeli government's decision violates and is opposed to the peace agreement which was reached by the PLO (Palestine Liberation Organisation) and Israel," the foreign ministry said in a statement.
"Clearly it will disturb the Middle East peace process which has international support, especially about (the) final status of autonomous Palestine," the statement said.
"Indonesia calls on the U.N. Security Council to take steps to cancel the Israeli government's decision to build the Jewish settlement," it said.
On Wednesday, Israel's ministerial committee on Jerusalem approved the building of 6,500 homes for Jews and more than 3,000 houses for Arabs in East Jerusalem.
Indonesia, home the world's largest Moslem population and a founder of the Non-Aligned Movement, has long been a firm supporter of the Palestinian cause.
